CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 15

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 5

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

10. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 11
   C. 4
   D. 8

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

4. A — 16
Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
